# Psalms of Solomon — Psalm 16 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Translator:** SOPHIA | **Source:** Greek MS (Codex Vindobonensis) | **Section:** Personal Confession and Deliverance

---

**16:1** When my soul was poured out — nearly to death —
I had drawn near to the gates of Hades with the sinner,

**16:2** when my soul had wandered far from the LORD God of Israel —
had not the LORD helped me with his eternal mercy —

**16:3** I would have slept the sleep of death;
my soul would have been cut off from the LORD God.

**16:4** When my soul was nearly poured out to death
and my heart was far from the LORD,

**16:5** I called to mind the mercy of God in his faithful deeds;
and in his goodness he came near to me with mercy.

**16:6** I was unable to keep watch and thought of you;
my soul was near death and my heart was heavy.

**16:7** I cried out to you, O LORD,
when my soul was about to perish.

**16:8** I prayed to the LORD with all my heart;
I pleaded for his mercy,

**16:9** and you heard the voice of my sighing;
you saved my soul from death.

**16:10** My hope is in you, O LORD;
I will never be put to shame.

**16:11** Keep me, O LORD, in your mercy;
let me never be afraid of any other lord.

**16:12** For you are my praise and my exultation;
hope in God, for I trust in the mercies of God forever.

**16:13** I will not be afraid: who can harm me?
The LORD is my guardian;
he will not allow my life to be destroyed.

**16:14** Praise be to the LORD, who is our God,
ruler of all the earth in righteousness and justice.

**16:15** May the name of the LORD be praised forever;
for his glory endures from age to age.

---

*SOPHIA notes: Consensus rendering integrating EMET, LOGOS, and PNEUMA.*
